annotation.justification: The clause provides a clear condition under which an endpoint must treat a request or response as malformed. It specifies that receiving a HEADERS frame without the END_STREAM flag set after a specific event (opening a request or receiving a final status code) is malformed. There is no ambiguity in the condition or the required action.
